reason: €600 is a lot of money for one apartment, and it's November, so I'm closed and nothing is coming in until spring. My Facebook page brings me guests, and if I want a site my nephew can try Wix for free.
objection: Who owns the domain and the site if I stop paying the €15? You say it's mine, but I want to know if I can take it somewhere else without losing everything I paid €600 for.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price for a simple one-page site for one apartment, paid in spring when the bookings start, with the domain transfer written down on paper.
